answer_1.quote: Opinion summarization is the task of automatically generating summaries from multiple documents containing users' thoughts on businesses or products.

answer_2.quote: We used two automatic measures: ROUGE-{1,2,L} and BERT-score.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a user study. We recruited 10 NLP experts and asked each participant to choose one best and one worst summary from four summaries for three criteria.
answer_4.guideline: Best-Worst Scaling (BWS) where participants select the best and worst summary for each of the criteria: Grammaticality, Coherence, Overall.
